# Code provenance (AI-assisted files)

The abstract promises that every AI-assisted file is recorded here, for the
code-provenance section of the report. Be honest in this file: examiners can ask
any member to explain any line they committed.

**What "AI-assisted" means here:** the first version of the file was generated by
Claude (Anthropic) in Claude Code, from our abstract, build plan and
`docs/interfaces.md`, and was then checked by running the testbenches and scripts
listed below. The member who commits a file is responsible for understanding it,
writing its golden table by hand first, and filling in the "reviewed by" column.

Files marked **(you write)** in the commit plans (golden tables, learning logs,
lab notes, drawings) are written by the team, not by AI. Do not list them here.
